findings.description: The production scale_bank makes answers consecutive multiples of a shared factor. Multiplying the common spacing by the visible linear coefficient yields the correct square-root derivative or slope; negating that multiplier handles reciprocal roots. This bypasses outer differentiation and target evaluation despite shuffled positions.
findings.reproduction: Run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python -B shortcut_probe.py batch-records.json; exit 1 demonstrates failure. Minimal current case: seed 3173462203, easy, slope_sqrt_radio, parameters a=7,b=37,t=-4. For y=sqrt(37+7x), sorted choices are 1,7/6,4/3,3/2,5/3. Their spacing is 1/6, so choose 7×1/6=7/6 without evaluating the radicand or target. The same record survives delivery.
